title: 第23章 喜欢我送的礼物吗
novel_title: 开局废灵根，成了宗门团宠小师叔
content_zh:
萧易寒？

    顾念念叨叨道：“你跟萧师侄的名字很像呢，他叫萧易水，你叫萧易寒！你们就差一个字！好巧啊！”

    空气里又响起一声很轻的笑声，带着微微的寒凉。

    “是很巧！”

    顾念念不是很舒服，她挣脱他的手，人往后面退了两步，歪着头打量。

    看了一会儿，她问：“你这样我都看不清你长什么样了。”

    桃夭和小六防备地盯着他，就连识海里的小灰也在说，这只是那个男人的一个投影。

    他的真身被压在这座山下的大阵里。

    他们都在告诉她，不要去看，不要好奇。

    这人是魔，古魔！

    甚至小灰还说，眼前这位是这天地间唯一的古魔。

    小灰：“古魔不死不灭，先前是我想错了，我以为只是普通的魔，可他不是，主人离开这里，不然会很危险。”

    萧易寒轻轻叹气。

    “很抱歉，我现在无法让你看清，如果你想看，可以去那里。”

    他指了一个方向。

    顾念念想了想问：“魔会吃人吗？”

    萧易寒愣了一瞬，随后溢出几声笑声。

    “相信我，如果可以，我恨不得把这世间所有的宝物都送给你。”

    顾念念听懂了。

    所以她跟小灰说：“他不危险，去看看吧，而且我能感觉到混沌原力就在那个方向。”

    小灰依然觉得危险。

    “主人，古魔是这个世上最危险最狡猾的物种，不能信他。”

    “可是他看上去很礼貌。”

    她跟老乞丐在皇城根下的时候，见过太多贵人面慈心恶，那些看上去很好的贵人，事实上眼里是冷的。

    可眼前的萧易寒眼底虽然也冷，却不是那种冷，她不知道要怎么解释，总之感觉不坏。

    “我想相信他。”

    小灰……

    桃夭劝他：“小灰，这人太强了，我们两个加在一起也打不过，要是他是坏的，用不着这么骗我们，直接下手就可以了。”

    小灰无语，最后颓了气势，只能默认。

    小六被桃夭压着，不赞同也只能赞同了。

    顾念念跟萧易寒说：“那走吧。”

    说着，她就往那个方向走。

    萧易寒跟在她的身边，目光却有意无意地看向了某一处，只一眼就收回了。

    躲在暗处的星元被这一眼看得惊出了一身冷汗。

    “萧冰块你这哥哥太吓人了，我刚刚要是露出一点恶意，不不不，我只要眼神稍有不对，他刚刚那个眼神不会那么温和。”

    他十分夸张地护着自己的脖子，满脸的心有余悸。
content_en:
Xiao Yihan?

    Gu Nian muttered: "You and Junior Nephew Xiao's names are very similar. His name is Xiao Yishui and your name is Xiao Yihan! There is only one word difference between you! What a coincidence!"

    Another soft laugh sounded in the air, with a slight chill.

    "What a coincidence!"

    Gu Niannian felt uncomfortable. She broke away from his hand and took two steps back, tilting her head to look at him.

    After looking at it for a while, she asked, "I can't even see what you look like when you're like this."

    Tao Yao and Xiao Liu stared at him defensively, and even Xiao Hui in the sea of consciousness said that this was just a projection of that man.

    His true body was suppressed in the large formation at the foot of this mountain.

    They were all telling her not to look, not to be curious.

    This person is a demon, an ancient demon!

    Xiao Hui even said that the person in front of him was the only ancient demon in the world.

    Xiao Hui: "The ancient demon is immortal. I was wrong before. I thought it was just an ordinary demon, but he is not. Master, leave here, otherwise it will be very dangerous."

    Xiao Yihan sighed softly.

    "I'm sorry, I can't let you see clearly now. If you want to see it, you can go there."

    He pointed in a direction.

    Gu Niannian thought for a moment and asked, "Can demons eat people?"

    Xiao Yihan was stunned for a moment, and then burst into laughter.

    "Believe me, if I could, I would give you all the treasures in the world."

    Gu Niannian understood.

    So she told Xiao Hui: "He is not dangerous, go and have a look, and I can feel the chaos force in that direction."

    Xiao Hui still felt dangerous.

    "Master, the ancient demon is the most dangerous and cunning species in the world. You cannot trust him."

    "But he seemed polite."

    When she and the old beggar were at the foot of the imperial city, they had seen too many noble people with kind faces and evil hearts. Those noble people who looked nice actually had cold eyes.

    But although the eyes of Xiao Yihan in front of her were cold, they were not that cold. She didn't know how to explain it, but it didn't feel bad anyway.

    "I want to believe him."

    Xiao Hui...

    Tao Yao advised him: "Xiao Hui, this man is too strong. The two of us together can't beat him. If he is bad, there is no need to lie to us like this, just attack him directly."

    Xiao Hui was speechless, and finally lost his momentum and could only acquiesce.

    Xiao Liu was suppressed by Tao Yao, so he could only agree if he didn't agree.

    Gu Niannian said to Xiao Yihan: "Let's go then."

    With that said, she walked in that direction.

    Xiao Yihan followed her, but his eyes looked at a certain place intentionally or unintentionally, and then he looked away with just one glance.

    Xingyuan, who was hiding in the dark, was so shocked by this sight that he broke into a cold sweat.

    "Xiao Bingcui, your brother is too scary. If I showed any malice just now, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, if my eyes were slightly wrong, his eyes wouldn't be so gentle just now."

    He protected his neck in an exaggerated manner, with a look of lingering fear on his face.
title_en: Chapter 23 Do you like the gift I gave you?
